title: Merged-branch margins on LCM laws live only in wasted cells and never compile
statement: For d_psi = d_lambda = 1, atomless P with tie-nullity ((M4)) and linear conditional means along the relevant tilt range (LCM; jointly Gaussian and elliptical laws): every bounded-packet stationary quantizer q with positive masses and full-rank I_q has (1) NON-DISTINCT projected centroids (under bare (L) this already follows from DS-STABLE-BASINS-CENTERED-OBSTRUCTION); (2) a reduced rule (merging coincident-e groups, DS12) that is a genuine strip rule with K' <= K-1 cells and rank(I_reduced) <= 1, hence lambda_min(I_reduced) = 0: the compilable reduction NEVER carries a nuisance margin; (3) the exact value identity Phi(q) = sum_g W_g E[e_q | G_g]^2 - the between-value of the projected law on at most K-1 intervals, with Phi(q) <= v_K always; (4) NONEMPTINESS: on N(0, I_2) the sign-split family (threshold cell plus any zero-mean measurable nuisance split of the other half) is stationary with I_q = diag(2/pi, I_11(split)) > 0, lambda_min up to 1/pi, and profiled value exactly v_2 = 2/pi for every member - so the population constraint class {lambda_min(I_q) >= kappa} of DS16's v*(kappa) is NONEMPTY for kappa <= 1/pi while every found inhabitant pays at least v_3 - v_2 = 0.1732 and is compile-dead. (M5) is exactly the load-bearing separation hypothesis of the full-triple obstruction.
assumptions: d_psi = d_lambda = 1; atomless P; tie hyperplanes null ((M4) suffices); E S = 0, finite second moments
LCM on the tilt range containing B*_q for conclusions (2)-(3) rank collapse; conclusion (1) needs only (L); conclusion (4) is a construction on the canonical Gaussian
stationarity is DS12 bounded-packet stationarity with I_q > 0; no claim about finite exchange-stable states tracking these configurations (that empirical question is part of the OP30 rescope)

value identity uses the DS11 variational normal equation at B = B*_q; the sharp bound Phi(q) <= v_{K-1}(shat-law) is proved only when B*_q = B*_pop (e.g. nuisance-sign-symmetric configurations) and is otherwise open

proof_location.section: DS17. Inhabitation of the margin-certified branch: the conditional-centering obstruction and the fixed-point gate

role: classifies the (M5)-free escape of the obstruction: margins survive only by wasting cells on profiled-information-free splits, and feed the DS16 attainment question a nonvacuous feasible class
warning: Nonemptiness of {lambda_min >= kappa} does not prove attainment of v*(kappa) or its continuity (audit-hardened DS16 conventions kept). Whether finite exchange-stable sequences can track sign-split configurations (ties are knife-edge) is open and recorded in the OP30 rescope.
